name: OCI NoSQL Pattern
summary: Builds and operates Oracle NoSQL Database Cloud Service access patterns (keys, indexes, transactions, consistency, TTL, IAM, encryption, replicas, provisioning, export/import recovery) as proposals gated on user approval, citing a per-claim evidence ledger.
security_notes: Static by default. Produces code, IaC and CLI as proposals; never runs writes, deployment, backfill, deletion, restore, feature changes or load tests without confirmed target, blast radius, rollback and user approval. Never requests credentials or prints customer data.
